snippet.title: Memories : Remember me / official trailer
snippet.description:
▼▼Play Now▼▼
http://onelink.to/memories-girl


Your destiny is suddenly thrust upon you! Are you ready to take it on together?
 
A long war has ruined the lives of many. Life has become meaningless, but a new one is about to begin.
Become the true main character in this tale of destiny that will be filled with cherished memories.

◆◆ A Lifestyle Game Determined by Your Choices ◆◆
From a 10-year-old child to an 18-year-old teenager, 8 years will fly by faster than you think.
Raise these adorable children to be a part of your family. Whatever you choose to do, that's life!
